en: The image shows a sepia-toned vintage photograph of a hillside with several large, ornate houses or villas. The architecture features steeply pitched roofs, arched windows, and decorative woodwork, typical of late 19th or early 20th-century Central or Eastern European mountain resorts. The houses are set against a backdrop of forested hills. The postcard is slightly faded with no visible text on the front.
